description: Cost of filling a tank (gallons times this week's EIA average for the area, or your price per gallon), and optionally the fuel cost of a trip from miles and miles per gallon, including cents per mile.

area.description: US, a state name or code ("Texas", "CA"), a city EIA prices ("Chicago", "NYC"), or an EIA region ("Midwest", "PADD 2"). Default US. A state EIA does not price is answered with its region.

miles.description: Trip distance in miles. Give with miles_per_gallon.

miles_per_gallon.description: Your vehicle fuel economy. Give with miles.

price_per_gallon.description: Your own price per gallon. Default the EIA average for the area.

name: estimate_fill_up_cost
title: Estimate fill-up and trip cost
